snippet.title: Rockstar Should Have Let Jerry Play GTA 6
snippet.description:
Jerry, known online as VoidOnly, wanted to live long enough to play GTA 6. Sadly, he never got that chance.

In this video, I explain why I believe Rockstar should have stepped in and tried to help him experience the game. His story meant something to people across the gaming community, and I think this was an opportunity to do something compassionate.

This is my criticism of how the situation was handled, not a claim that Rockstar directly rejected a confirmed request.

Rest in peace, Jerry. My condolences to his family, friends, and everyone who supported him.

snippet.title: Gamers Who Never Got to Play GTA 6 💔 Rest in Peace
snippet.description:
They waited for GTA VI... but never got to play it. 🕊️

A tribute to the gamers and creators we lost before GTA VI came out.

Chapters:
0:00 Intro
0:13 Jerry Fort "Void Only"
1:19 Twomad
2:22 Jean Pormanove "JP"
3:27 P2istheName
4:29 Komanche
5:37 Manuel Otto
6:40 Comicstorian
7:43 Dedeco
8:47 Rest in peace, soldiers

In memory of:
🕊️ Jerry Fort "Void Only" (25) – 2026
🕊️ Twomad (Muudea Sedik, 23) – 2024
🕊️ Jean Pormanove "JP" (Raphaël Graven, 46) – 2025
🕊️ P2istheName (Philip Enewally, 26) – 2025
🕊️ Komanche (Carlos Mauricio Gómez, 30) – 2026
🕊️ Manuel Otto (Stick Run creator, 30) – 2026
🕊️ Comicstorian (Ben Potter, 40) – 2024
🕊️ Dedeco (André Luiz Berbett Pinheiro Lopes, 33) – 2026

And thousands more soldiers we lost along the way.
Before you play GTA VI, give a moment for them. Rest in peace.

If you are going through a hard time, you are not alone. Talk to someone you trust or find a free helpline in your country: 

Info from news reports: Deertoe, NBC News, CBS News, Kotuku, TheWrap, IBTimes.
